item.content:encoded:
So, my initial thoughts were that this is way too obtuse — about 10 footnotes in on mobile, I was already a bit frustrated and had to move onto a computer to finish reading. And after going through this more than once, I was able to "get" what was going on, and holy actual shit!! This is definitely something you need to sit down and pore over for a while, because there is so much involved and it's among the most far-out and wacky shit I've read on the site. And, really, that's no exaggeration!1

I also have to agree with Shaggy above — the technique of an interview continuing after its formal end is unique, and used to great effect here. It provides a lot of extra development to two already interesting characters (who are, seriously, weird in all the best ways), and further insight into the "twist" phenomenon and what/where/whenever it is these characters came from.

Also: I've taken the liberty of making some wording/SPaG adjustments to this translation, so that it adheres more closely to the original Russian in some places while remaining in proper English.

Footnotes
1. If I had to compare, the closest to this that I've read — in terms of feeling — are SCP-2682 and SCP-4972, respectively.

What the actual fuck?

These two are on another level entirely. I was only about half sure what was going on at any given time amidst all their bickering and banter, but they're certainly odd and brimming with personality.

Double bonus points for leaving the camera rolling, so to speak. I've not seen an interview done like that before. Strong +1!
